title: Unit {label}
deactivated: This unit has past contracts, so it was deactivated instead of deleted.
floorHint: −1 for basement, 0 for ground; leave empty for roof
noContract: No active contract for this unit

restructure.title: Merge or split units
restructure.help: Select source units, then define the resulting units. Historical units and contracts are retained. Resolve live or draft leases first. A PACI number may be shared by the resulting units.
restructure.label: Unit number/label
restructure.mergeHelp: Select two or more units to create one unit. Its label, type and total asking rent are prefilled and can be edited before saving.
restructure.splitHelp: Select one source unit and create two or more result units. Suggested labels and asking rents can be edited.
restructure.chooseMergeSources: Select at least two source units to merge.
restructure.chooseSplitSource: Select one source unit to split.
restructure.reasonRequired: Enter the reason for merging or splitting to save.
restructure.labelsRequired: Enter a label for each result unit.
restructure.duplicateLabel: Result labels must be distinct and must not match another unit in the property.
restructure.invalidResult: Check result unit details: labels are required and rent cannot be negative.
restructure.invalidPaci: PACI is optional; when supplied it must contain eight digits.
